newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BALLAST NEDAM TO CLOSE ANTILLES UNIT.
newsitem.headline: BALLAST NEDAM TO CLOSE ANTILLES UNIT.

text.p: Dutch builder Ballast Nedam said on Monday it was closing down its Netherlands Antilles unit in Curacao with annual turnover of about 20 million guilders.
A spokeswoman said the unit had been losing about two million guiders annually in recent years.
Ballast Nedam has already set aside some 1.5 million guilders to cover the costs of the closure.
Ballast Nedam, which had a turnover of 3.8 billion guilders in 1996, said competition in the Antilles was getting tougher while the amount of orders was decreasing.
